messages:
maya: quick heads-up: saw websocket sessions marked active in console while clients reported immediate RST + reconnects, caused duplicate billing windows. tcpdump shows RST from nginx ~35s idle but runtime never emits close so console stays green.

leo: stack? nginx -> ILB -> envoy -> runtime?

maya: exactly. snippet: 
08:22:11.001 IP 10.1.2.3.443 > 10.2.3.4.52344: RST
runtime: no close for ~6s, then client reconnects.

ashwin: we only flip CLOSED on app EOF; propose console-only state change on socket RST behind FF + telemetry. keep resume token valid for short TTL so sticky resume still works.

ui: console should show "idle-probed (tcp-rst)" and a hint about billing investigation.

billing-bot: created BL-562 to add idempotency guard for short duplicate windows (maya assigned).

maya: patch plan: emit metric ws_idle_rst{layer,route}, mark_console_stale(session, reason="tcp_rst"), extend_resume_ttl(session,10s). FF gated.

leo: add histogram for tcp-event -> console-state latency.

ashwin: rollout: canary console-FF for 48h, collect metrics, then decide on routing semantics via RFC.

maya: canary started in us-west-canary; will post aggregates.

ui: also add UI toggle to exclude "probe-terminated" windows from cost graphs while we debug.

maya: thanks, will follow up with pcap samples and histograms.
